_doc: Cach goi CLI cua tung agent o che do headless. {prompt} duoc thay bang noi dung that. 'cmd' dung cho luot review: phai DOC va TRUY CAP WEB duoc nhung KHONG GHI duoc. 'write_cmd' dung cho luot tac gia. 'output_file_flag' danh cho CLI co stdout lan nhieu: orchestrator them co do kem mot file tam va doc ket qua tu do. Xem AGENTS.md muc 8.

write_cmd: Read Grep Glob WebFetch WebSearch Write Edit
claude.note: Da kiem chung 2026-09-09 bang subprocess: doc OK, WebFetch OK (ca dang cach nhau bang space lan dau phay), Write bi chan that. Khong dung --permission-mode plan: no chan luon WebFetch. Luu y: agent co the bao nham la WebFetch bi chan — da do lai va no chay duoc.

gemini.note: Antigravity CLI (agy), khong phai 'gemini' CLI nua: Google da ngat OAuth cua gemini CLI cho tai khoan ca nhan tu 2026-06-18 (Gemini Code Assist for individuals / AI Pro / Ultra), chi con API key tra tien moi dung duoc. Da kiem chung 2026-09-09 tren may AnhTu bang subprocess: doc file trong repo OK khong can --add-dir, web OK (mo example.com that), ghi BI CHAN that. Canh bao: --mode plan KHONG phai hang rao — do lai thi no van ghi duoc file. Chan ghi la nho permissions.deny ['write_file(*)','command(*)'] trong ~/.gemini/antigravity-cli/settings.json. Vi vay write_cmd o day chua dung duoc: muon cho Gemini cam vai tac gia thi phai go deny do ra truoc. AGENTS.md muc 2 va muc 8 khong giao cho Gemini vai tac gia o buoc nao nen tam thoi khong can. Dang nhap: agy dung chung phien voi app Antigravity da cai san.

codex.note: Da kiem chung 2026-09-09: doc OK, web OK, ghi bi chan o --sandbox read-only. stdout lan nhieu (web search:, tokens used) nen lay ket qua qua --output-last-message.
